elements.element: Customer may terminate the Agreement or an Order Form for convenience.
elements.evidence: The Company may terminate the Agreement for convenience and without cause.

elements.element: Customer's convenience termination requires no more than 30 days' written notice.
elements.evidence: The Company must give 90 days' written notice, exceeding 30 days.

elements.element: Vendor refunds prepaid fees pro rata after Customer's convenience termination.
elements.evidence: No pro-rata refund of prepaid fees is required.

elements.element: Vendor has no right to terminate for convenience during a committed term.
elements.evidence: HDI may terminate for convenience only effective at the end of the then-current term.

elements.element: Customer may terminate for convenience on 60 to 90 days' notice.
elements.evidence: The Company may terminate for convenience on 90 days' written notice.

elements.element: Any early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The Termination Payment may not exceed the aggregate Section 3.1 payments due for the three months preceding termination.

elements.element: Vendor may terminate for convenience only at the end of a term.
elements.evidence: HDI's convenience termination is permitted only effective at the end of the then-current term.

elements.element: Vendor must give at least 90 days' notice of convenience termination.
elements.evidence: HDI must provide 90 days' written notice.
